title: eBay’s Watchlist Trend Report reveals how fashion’s creative director shakeups are creating demand for archival items
summary: Drawing on data from 136 million active buyers and approximately 2.7 billion live listings, the Watchlist Trend Report for Fall/Winter 2026 explores how runway trends and cultural moments are influencing fashion discovery and resale behavior.
body_markdown:
**SAN JOSE, CALIFORNIA, November 10, 2026** —


eBay’s latest Watchlist Trend Report[ebay.com/thewatchlist](http://ebay.com/thewatchlist) reveals how creative director changes at Chanel, Dior, and Gucci are bringing renewed attention to the designers and collections that defined previous eras. As searches rise for Matthieu Blazy (+291%), Jonathan Anderson (+92%) and Demna (+42%), eBay data shows parallel momentum for the archives: listings for Karl Lagerfeld-era Chanel climbed 87%, average sale prices for John Galliano-era Dior increased 81%, and listings for Tom Ford-era Gucci rose 49% year over year.


The influence of the runway extends beyond creative director debuts. Following Prada’s Spring 2027 show, searches for “Prada skirt” surged 360% on eBay compared to the beginning of the month. Meanwhile, as Loewe and Bottega Veneta revisit their archives, global listings for the Amazona 180 and Veneta bags climbed 440% and 158%, respectively.


eBay Resident Stylist Brie Welch, who regularly sources fashion from eBay for both her personal wardrobe and her celebrity clients Uma Thurman and Katie Holmes, shares her perspective on the season’s key trends and how to translate runway inspiration into everyday style. Her curated storefront offers shoppers a way to discover and shop her favorite finds at[ebay.com/inf/briewelchstorefront](http://ebay.com/inf/briewelchstorefront) .


“This season’s Watchlist reads like a style diary of everyone shopping on eBay: the eras they’re revisiting, the pieces they’re investing in, and the moments in culture they can’t stop thinking about,” said Brie Welch, “What’s moving on eBay right now tells a story, from archival influences to special finds that are perfect holiday gifts and watches meant for a special night out. I wanted to show how to bring those themes into everyday style, whether that’s one standout piece or a whole look.”


This holiday season, eBay Live will turn Watchlist insights into shoppable experiences, with special streams featuring sellers including[Vookum](https://www.ebay.com/ebaylive/events/LdbJZEaSdasclg9A) ,[Reserved](https://www.ebay.com/ebaylive/events/aoKMzOM3CdcvKfjG)[Luxury](https://www.ebay.com/ebaylive/events/aoKMzOM3CdcvKfjG) and[Bolt](https://www.ebay.com/ebaylive/events/ACh9VjQYKL2TB7Ly)[Luxury](https://www.ebay.com/ebaylive/events/ACh9VjQYKL2TB7Ly) . Shoppers can discover rare and coveted luxury gifts inspired by the trends impacting resale demand starting November 15th at[ebay.com/ebaylive](https://www.ebay.com/ebaylive) .


**eBay’s Watchlist Trend Report includes:**


### THE DISCOVERY EDIT


*What shoppers are searching for and discovering on eBay, at every price point.*


**


As new creative directors reshape fashion’s biggest houses, shoppers are revisiting the designers who defined previous eras, from Karl Lagerfeld’s Chanel, Tom Ford’s Gucci and John Galliano’s Dior.


### THE RESALE EDIT


*The pieces rising in value and emerging as the next collector’s items.*


** Iconic designs are gaining new momentum on resale, from revived archival handbags to statement pieces finding new audiences. The most coveted bags in fashion now have a growing menswear following, with global listings rising for Loewe's reimagined Amazona 180 and Bottega Veneta's Intrecciato Andiamo.


### THE CULTURE EDIT


*How cultural moments translate to resale demand.*


**


From the runway to the red carpet, cultural moments translate into measurable shifts in shopping behavior on eBay. Following Matthieu Blazy’s debut at Chanel, searches for the designer surged, while Chanel climbed the ranks of eBay’s most-purchased luxury brands.
